reason: Owner clarified that Sheep Tag Quest A/X selection wheels must never freeze sheep locomotion: left joystick must continue to move the sheep while right stick chooses houses/skills. v11.214 had a gameplay regression: it zeroed se199StickIntent, canceled the held VR movement order and suppressed camera follow whenever the wheel opened. §E v11.216 (source-verified PR #330 merged at 30b6a1e4fd4e7ae50332168234b5c7dd0254c0aa) appends a minimal fix atop the concurrently published v11.215 Floating Hand thumb/ulnar anatomy release. It restores the native collision-checked se199StickIntent while a house/ability wheel is open, does not reset se200.stickHeld or cancel an in-progress VR movement order, and allows original se195FollowCamera to keep world view following moving sheep without catch-up snap on closing. v11.204 already neutralizes camera orbit/zoom from the right selection stick while the wheel is open; raw gamepad axes still select options. v11.214 world-up yaw-only head-follow radial and duplicate beam/ground guide suppression remain; native headset pose unchanged. v11.211 Meta OS Camera focus recovery, v11.210 spatial menus, authoring/modeler, LAN authority, quick-build grid, 68 original assets and the full v11.215 hand anatomy upgrade are preserved. 50 new live-movement wheel assertions and all prior v11.214/211/210/209/205/204/203/200/199/193/192 targeted regressions PASSED; 248 append-only patches, exact HTML 7,493,268 bytes SHA256 354f8cce2b5833991fb6fd8d30390b096682def3956b2290a5468451f2a1e643, sealed by GitHub Actions #41470944157. Real physical Quest 2 comfort and FPS remain unverified.
